CHAPTER 2 · ITEM 02 / 12

Economic thinking and models

Micro, macro & statements微觀、宏觀與陳述

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Distinguish microeconomics from macroeconomics, and positive statements that can be tested from normative judgments about what ought to happen.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

微觀研究個人及市場，宏觀研究整體經濟。實證陳述原則上可檢驗；規範陳述涉及應該如何做的價值觀。

Microeconomics studies individual choices and markets; macroeconomics studies aggregate outcomes. Positive claims can be tested against evidence; normative claims include a value judgment about what ought to happen.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：“A tax reduces purchases” is positive; “The government should impose it” is normative. 稅是否減少購買可測試，應否徵稅含價值判斷。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

Which is normative? 哪句是規範陳述？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
